correctness.rationale: By Konig bipartite line coloring, induced rook graph 3-colorability is equivalent to all selected row/column degrees <=3. Inclusion maximality holds iff every missing cell meets a saturated row or column, equivalently all low-row x low-column cells are present. Each low-row/column set has size at most two. Summing deficits alpha=3m-|E|, beta=3n-|E| forces low-pattern exceptions only at square n=m and n=m+1. Unique low-coordinate choices with 3-regular A_r and single-defect H_r degree margin coefficients count disjoint families; m=n=3 vanishing A_2/H_2 correctly leaves z^9. Independent enumeration agrees at 3x3,3x4,4x4.
